investigations.name: Stadtwerke Schwerte GmbH
investigations.decision: remain partial; current first-party network expansion invalidates sampled-estate inference

evidence.currentFirstParty: Stadtwerke Schwerte currently describes its own public charging network and states charging is possible via ladenetz.de roaming/charging-card paths; a 2026 expansion project adds further charging infrastructure.
evidence.previousDirectSample: Bahnhofstrasse direct observation 0.38 EUR/kWh remains station-scoped only.

investigations.exactGap: No current first-party anonymous/direct numeric tariff matrix was established for the expanded active estate, and the single Bahnhofstrasse value cannot be extended to new or other sites.
investigations.resumeCondition: Current public ladeapp/QR direct checkout prices per active Schwerte EVSE or a first-party estate-wide anonymous tariff statement.

evidence.currentFirstParty: Public charging is available at Stadtwerke Luebbecke locations; spontaneous/direct charging is supported through the charging infrastructure/payment route.
evidence.previousSample: 0.49 EUR/kWh AC observations remain sampled, not estate-wide.

investigations.exactGap: No authoritative current per-EVSE anonymous matrix or deterministic rule was found that closes all active sites/power classes and fee components.
investigations.resumeCondition: eCharge+/public backend per-EVSE direct-price export or first-party anonymous tariff rule with explicit scope and fees.

nextSafeAction: Continue another small B1/B3/B6 candidate with an exhaustible public direct-payment surface; prefer a candidate with a known small fixed site count over expanded municipal estates.
